Schema and database agree. Migration 0025_mfa.sql once added users.mfaSecret / mfaEnabledAt / mfaLastUsedStep and an mfa_recovery_codes table that prisma/schema.prisma never declared. The client declined MFA, so 0026_remove_mfa.sql drops all of it — which also closes that drift: prisma/schema.prisma is now an accurate description of D1 again. Login is single-factor by design.

Conventions in this schema. · D1 does not enforce foreign keys — several "references" are application-enforced only (expense_line_items.sourceItemId, recipe_components.source*, and the cat / trade / unit text columns pointing at the lookup tables). · Money is never recomputed from a live join: recipe_components.amount and expense_line_items.amount are stored snapshots. · Paid / outstanding are derived on read — sum(expense_payments.amount) against expenses.amount, never stored.
